data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fawne represents the goddess of dawn and new beginnings. Derived from the Greek word phaos, meaning 'bright' or 'shining'. The name Fawne carries the meaning “Dawn, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fawne usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
